_comment: Single source of truth for ResilientMesh economics. Go reads this file via internal/config.LoadCostModel; Python reads it in eval/benchmark.py. Both MUST read it so the live policy engine and the offline NRCV benchmark can never price the same incident differently. Values mirror domain.DefaultCostModel().
_units: paisa (1 rupee = 100 paisa); integer arithmetic only, never floats in money math
